site.name: The Bradbury Group (benchmark, March 2026 snapshot)
site.evidence_source: Evidence pasted from the manual audit 'Website - Analysis and Audit' (UX Research-TBG/), which recorded the live page in March 2026. The live site could not be fetched from the build environment, so the agent judged levels from that recorded evidence only.

summary: A credible, well-written consultancy page whose conversion path breaks at the first click. The hero CTA and the Consulting 'Learn More' both leave for ElevenLabs, the advertised Columbus assessment is a contact form, and every service is a #anchor on one page, so nothing ranks for service queries. Founder story, named testimonials and the FAQ are real assets.

findings.title: Primary hero CTA leaves the site for ElevenLabs

evidence.quote: Discover Your AI Readiness -> elevenlabs.io/app/talk-to?agent_id=...

findings.why: The session is lost at the first click; consulting buyers rarely come back.
findings.fix: Embed the ElevenLabs/Columbus agent on-site as an inline widget or branded modal; never let the primary CTA exit the domain.

findings.title: Columbus 3-minute assessment CTA opens a contact form

evidence.quote: Take our 3-minute assessment guided by AI assistant Columbus -> #contact

findings.why: A broken promise at peak intent is worse than no promise.
findings.fix: Wire 'Let's Go!' to the real Columbus assessment; if it does not exist yet, remove the copy.

findings.title: Services exist only as #anchors on one page

evidence.quote: #about, #services, #reviews, #faq

findings.why: Nothing can rank for 'AI training for L&D teams' or 'AI keynote speaker'.
findings.fix: Create /training/, /consulting/ and /speaking/ pages with unique copy and keywords, following the /solomon-engine/ model; point nav and cards at them.

findings.title: Seven headline statistics have no source

evidence.quote: 92% adoption rates
40% reduction in course development time

findings.why: Analytical L&D and C-suite buyers discount unsourced numbers.
findings.fix: Footnote each stat with its source or 'based on N client cohorts, 2024-25'; drop any that cannot be sourced.

findings.title: Hero (and H1) duplicated in the DOM

evidence.quote: Stop Implementing AI Tools. Start Architecting Human Performance.

findings.why: Duplicate H1 dilutes signals and screen readers announce it twice.
findings.fix: Replace the mobile/desktop clones with one responsive hero and a single H1.

findings.title: Partner logos are unnamed

evidence.quote: 1.png, 3.png, sweet.png (no alt)

findings.why: Microsoft/SAP/Coursera equity is invisible to people and crawlers.
findings.fix: Add brand-name alt text and a caption or hover label to each logo; use monochrome PNGs.

findings.title: 'Book A Call Today' has no booking mechanism

evidence.quote: only a logo and tagline text

findings.why: Adds 24-72 hours of back-and-forth to the conversion moment.
findings.fix: Embed a Cal.com or Calendly inline scheduler in the section.

findings.title: 'Guiding Principles' and Consulting 'Learn More' CTAs misdirect

evidence.quote: -> #contact
-> elevenlabs.io

findings.why: Each misdirection lowers trust in the next CTA.
findings.fix: Point each CTA at the content its label names (principles section, /consulting/ page).

findings.title: No case studies with measurable outcomes

evidence.quote: No case studies with before/after detail

findings.fix: Publish 2-3 case studies using the case-study template (challenge, intervention, metric).

findings.title: WCAG basics fail: stock/filename alt, no skip link

evidence.quote: Young asia student study in the public library, She makes note on notebook.

findings.fix: Rewrite alt text, add a skip link, check secondary-text contrast in services.

findings.title: No CTA after the named testimonials

evidence.quote: Korn Ferry, Purdue Global; next element is not a CTA

findings.fix: Add the primary 'Book a consultation' button directly after the testimonials.

findings.title: No schema markup

evidence.quote: No schema markup evident for FAQPage, Person, Service

findings.fix: Add FAQPage JSON-LD on the FAQ, Person on the founder bio and Service on each service URL.

findings.title: Stock-library alt text on service images

evidence.quote: Young asia student study in the public library...

findings.fix: Replace with descriptive, keyworded alt text per image.

findings.title: Internal links are anchors, not pages

evidence.quote: #services, #contact

findings.fix: Link services, blog posts and future case studies to each other with descriptive anchor text.

findings.title: No engagement model or price signal

evidence.quote: Consulting, Training, Speaking: no pricing or engagement model

findings.fix: Add an engagement-model line per service (format, duration, 'from' price or 'typical engagement').

findings.title: CTAs use three unrelated styles

evidence.quote: some bordered, some filled, some plain text links

findings.fix: Define primary (Mustard Gold fill), secondary (outline) and text-link styles and apply site-wide.
